content: Local-first tools (Super Productivity, Obsidian, Logseq) treat readable-format on-disk data plus built-in JSON/CSV export as table stakes; proprietary/locked formats with no export are the named anti-pattern. Zero telemetry / no phone-home is the default expectation for local-first; where telemetry exists it is opt-in with first-launch disclosure. Open-source auditability of the no-telemetry claim is part of the value proposition.
